text.p: - The U.S. Defence Ministry recieved from Russia a 2,000-page report on all nuclear tests conducted in the Soviet Union since 1949.
- Russian engineer Gennady Nikonov, from the city of Izhevsk, has designed a new machine-gun which is said to be more powerful than the famous Kalashnikov.
- Moscow wants to tighten control over the regions in a campaign to be headed by the President's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais.

- Russia is concerned about weakening of its position in the former Soviet republics of Central Asia. Russia's defence minister Igor Rodionov has arrived in the Tajik capital Dushanbe to improve this situation at a CIS defence ministers' meeting.
- Political preparations for the President Yeltsin's surgery are apparently over. Discipline in the executive power structures has been tightened, opponents have been appeased, at least temporarily.
- Different power structures have recently demonstrated the will to cooperate, says the president's deputy chief-of-staff Maxim Boiko.
- Futher cuts in the military budget will lead in a few years to Russia's inability to have an efficient army.
- Russian society is worried, anticipating Boris Yeltsin's heart sugery as doomsday.
